name: Princess Danger √2

source:
In search for Ayumi her most loyal follower Pochi goes on a big adventure. However, in the absence of invincible monarch a clever trap is set up by the west demonic gods. Will Pochi rescue Ayumi?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
为了寻找亚由美，她最忠诚的追随者波奇踏上了一场宏大的冒险。然而，无敌君主不在身边，西方魔神早已布下巧妙的陷阱。波奇能救出亚由美吗？
